text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy conquered the February 
Stakes. The spectators who had 
underestimated her were blown away by her 
magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy and Biko Pegasus praise each 
other's hard-fought efforts, acknowledging 
one another as rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Public perception has begun to shift, but 
only for some. She wants to show off her 
true ability even more in a GⅠ race. We 
decided on the Teio Sho as our next goal.
